name.value: Prestige Harbourfront Resort, BW Premier Collection

description.value: The Prestige Harbourfront Resort is Salmon Arm's only resort situated directly on Shuswap Lake, with views of the Columbia Mountains and waterfront access. It operates as a WorldHotels Luxury property under the BWH Hotels umbrella, drawing visitors for events like the Roots & Blues Festival and lakeside weddings. Touring cyclists finishing a day on the Shuswap routes will find a full-service resort experience in a notable scenic setting.
